headline: Predators are specialized for capture—evolution has optimized them for finding, catching, and consuming prey
universal_truth: Specialization creates capability; focus on one thing enables excellence at that thing
fun_facts: Cheetahs can accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in 3 seconds—faster than most sports cars
Owls can hear a mouse under snow from 75 feet away
Great white sharks can detect a single drop of blood in 25 gallons of water
discussion_questions: What capabilities have you developed through focus?
Where does your specialization give you advantage?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Eagles with telescopic vision. Cheetahs with explosive speed. Sharks with blood-detecting senses. Predators are evolutionary masterpieces—optimized for one purpose: catching prey. Their specialization is their power.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Predators aren't general-purpose—they're specialists. A cheetah can't fly, a shark can't climb, an owl can't outrun. What does their specialization teach us?

options.text: Excellence comes from focus—predators sacrificed versatility for specific capability; being the best at one thing often means being worse at others
options.response: Yes. The cheetah's speed came at cost: it's not strong, can't fight, overheats quickly. Specialization means trade-offs. Excellence in one area requires focus.

options.text: Predators are just born with natural abilities
options.response: Abilities are inherited, but they represent millions of years of focused evolutionary optimization...

q1.title: Optimization Trade-offs
q1.script: Every predator made trade-offs. Speed versus strength. Vision versus smell. Each specialization meant sacrificing something else. There are no free lunches in evolution—or in life.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Optimization Trade-offs"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Match to Environment
q2.script: Predators are matched to their prey and environment. Polar bears hunt seals on ice. Eagles hunt from sky. Sharks hunt in water. Capability matches context. Your strengths should match your arena.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Personal Predation
q3.script: What are you optimized to 'hunt'? What skills have you developed through focus? Knowing your capabilities helps you choose appropriate targets and environments. Hunt what you're built to catch.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Specialization creates capability. Focus on one thing enables excellence at that thing—but requires trade-offs. Know what you're built to hunt.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 248. Tomorrow, we'll explore animals that get hunted—prey. Until then, consider your specialized capabilities.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Specialization Inventory - What Are You Built For?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify specialized capabilities and appropriate targets
growTrack.activity: What are you optimized for? What capabilities have you developed through focus and practice? Are you hunting in the right environment for your specialization? Match your capabilities to your targets for best results.
